title: Wearables, with a shoot sheet — the model in the ad's outfit and light first, then the shots
covers: the same products as `wearable`, when likeness across shots and through the clip matters most: a shoot sheet of the cast member in the brief's wardrobe, place and light is made first (one extra image), and every still and clip references it

shots.direction: Medium shot of the model wearing or holding the product, looking into the camera, mid-movement; the product clearly visible in the frame's lower-middle third.
Close-up of the product on the model — hands, shoulder, wrist or face, whichever the product sits on — filling most of the frame so its details, texture and hardware read clearly.
Full-body shot of the model in the same place, the whole look with the product front and centre, a confident pose.
